note: World expansion: 23 trade goods, 5 materials, 23 pills/elixirs/teas, 6 poisons, 6 antidotes (2nd Rate to Transcendent) + 16 recipes. Import from Dashboard → Items → Import. Recipes that use Spirit Grass / Thousand-Year Ginseng / Green Antidote need the first pack.

items.name: Old Pine Resin
items.description: Amber resin from pines older than any dynasty. Calms the blood. Used in teas and incense (see Crafting).

items.name: Phoenix Tail Fern
items.description: A common fern of the southern hills, named for its shape. Draws out heat and fire poisons.

items.name: Snow Lotus
items.description: Blooms once a decade on the snow line of the western mountains. The base of cold, clean pills.

items.name: Purple Lingzhi
items.description: A purple ganoderma that grows on dead imperial pines. Prized by every alchemist.

items.name: Moon Dew
items.description: Dew gathered from lotus leaves on the night of the full moon. Spoils into ordinary water by dawn — unless sealed in jade.

items.name: Hundred Grains Pill
items.description:
A commoner's pill pressed from a hundred kinds of grain. Cheap, weak and honest.

**Gimmick:** **double Qi** if you take it where a **Famine or Drought** is happening.
-# Its price follows the local price of grain. Made for **2nd Rate**.

items.name: Morning Pine Pill
items.description:
Rolled at dawn from pine pollen and spirit grass.

-# Made for **2nd Rate**. 35% weaker for each one taken this month.

items.name: Red Cinnabar Pill
items.description:
The classic Taoist pill: cinnabar fired nine times. Strong — and full of mercury.

**Gimmick:** **+5 extra Impurity** if you already have 40 or more.
-# Made for **1st Rate**.

items.name: Winter Plum Pill
items.description:
Brewed from plum blossoms picked in the snow.

**Gimmick:** **×1.75 Qi in Winter**, ×0.5 in Summer. Max 3 per month.

items.name: Homeland Spring Pill
items.description:
Every sect brews it from the water of its own mountain springs.

**Gimmick:** **+50% Qi** when taken in land **your own faction rules**. Max 3 per month.

items.name: Snow Lotus Pill
items.description:
A cold, clean pill around a snow lotus heart.

-# Made for **Expert**. 30% weaker for each one taken this month.

items.name: Thousand-Year Ginseng Pill
items.description:
A whole thousand-year root refined into one pill.

-# Made for **Master**. Max 1 per month.

items.name: Purple Ganoderma Elixir
items.description:
A rare clean elixir: it feeds Qi **and** washes a little impurity away.

-# +5 Qi and −5 Impurity. Max 2 per month.

items.name: Nine-Turn Golden Pill
items.description:
Turned in the furnace nine times over forty-nine days.

-# Made for **Supreme Peak**. Max 2 per month.

items.name: Heaven-and-Earth Origin Pill
items.description:
Said to hold the Qi of the world before it split into Heaven and Earth. Only a handful exist.

-# Made for **Transcendent**. Max 1 per month. The shop rarely has more than two.

items.name: Ox Horn Pill
items.description:
Powdered horn of a mountain ox, bound with honey.

-# Made for **Master**. 35% weaker for each one taken this month.

items.name: Bear Gall Pill
items.description:
Bitter enough to make grown men weep. Toughens the body.

-# Made for **Master**. 35% weaker for each one taken this month.

items.name: Leopard Sinew Pill
items.description:
Loosens the tendons like a hunting leopard's.

-# Made for **Master**. 35% weaker for each one taken this month.

items.name: Golden Body Pill
items.description:
Tempers the whole body at once.

-# Gives 4 stat points (Strength / Endurance / Mobility). Made for **Peak**. Max 2 per month.

items.name: Myriad Forms Pill
items.description:
Lets the body become whatever the cultivator needs.

-# Gives 5 flexible points (any stat, including Qi). Made for **Supreme Peak**. Max 1 per month.

items.name: Mid-Autumn Moon Elixir
items.description:
Sealed under the harvest moon with moon dew.

**Gimmick:** +2% Realm Breakthrough — **+6% in Autumn**. Max 1 per month.

items.name: Bodhi Seed Incense
items.description:
Burned before seclusion by Shaolin elders.

**Gimmick:** +4% Realm Breakthrough, **kept if the attempt fails** — but only works with a calm mind: **wasted at 25+ Impurity**. No impurity. Max 1 per month.

items.name: Peak-Opening Pill
items.description:
Pries open the last gate of the Peak.

-# +6% Realm Breakthrough. Made for **Peak** → Supreme Peak. Max 1 per month.

items.name: Heavenly Gate Elixir
items.description:
Brewed once a generation for a sect master standing at the edge of Transcendence.

-# +7% Realm Breakthrough. Made for **Supreme Peak** → Transcendent. Max 1 per month.

items.name: Pine Needle Tea
items.description:
Bitter tea of pine needles and resin. A little cleaner each cup.

-# −3 Impurity. Max 4 per month. Its price follows the local price of tea.

items.name: Medicinal Bath Herbs
items.description:
A bundle of herbs for an hour-long medicinal bath.

-# −8 Impurity. Max 2 per month. Cheaper where medicine is plentiful.

items.name: Lotus Heart Decoction
items.description:
Lotus hearts simmered for a day and a night.

-# −20 Impurity. Max 2 per month.

items.name: Snow Mountain Ice Water
items.description:
Meltwater from the Kunlun glaciers, carried down in sealed jade.

**Gimmick:** removes **45 Impurity**, but **4 Qi** freezes away with it. Max 1 per month.

items.useEffect: Drunken Immortal Powder was slipped into the drink.
items.name: Drunken Immortal Powder

poison.debuff: +10 Impurity. If the target has 20+ Impurity: −5 Qi, −1 Qi Bar.
poison.gimmick: Wine-heavy limbs: the target's Mobility counts one tier lower for 1 turn.
poison.activation: Dissolved in wine or tea. Tasteless in strong liquor.

items.description: A tasteless powder sold under the counter in rowdy inns.

items.name: Centipede Ash

poison.debuff: +10 Impurity on hit. If the target has 20+ Impurity: −5 Qi, −1 Qi Bar.
poison.gimmick: The wound swells: T4 (Light) damage on the hit area, repeating over 2 turns.
poison.activation: Rubbed onto blades or hidden weapons; enters through broken skin.

items.description: Ash of burned giant centipedes, black and gritty.

items.useEffect: Needles coated with Silver Needle Toxin.
items.name: Silver Needle Toxin

poison.debuff: +10 Impurity on hit. If the target has 20+ Impurity: −5 Qi, −1 Qi Bar.
poison.gimmick: Hard to notice: the target only realises they were poisoned at the end of the next turn (unless they are Expert or above).
poison.activation: Coats hidden needles. One dose coats three needles.

items.description: A clear oil favoured by assassins because it does not tarnish silver.

items.useEffect: Weapon coated with Seven-Step Snake Venom.
items.name: Seven-Step Snake Venom

poison.debuff: +30 Impurity on hit. If the target has 20+ Impurity: −20 Qi, −2 Qi Bars, −5 Endurance.
poison.gimmick: Seven steps: if the target uses a movement technique while poisoned, the venom reaches the heart — +10 more Impurity.
poison.activation: Coats a blade; enters through broken skin.

items.description: From the snake whose bite, they say, lets you walk seven steps.

items.useEffect: A Corpse Flower Gu was hidden in the meal.
items.name: Corpse Flower Gu

poison.debuff: +30 Impurity. If the target has 20+ Impurity: −20 Qi, −2 Qi Bars, −5 Strength.
poison.gimmick: Dormant: it sleeps until the target spends Qi Bars, then wakes and eats one more Qi Bar.
poison.activation: Swallowed in food or drink. Southern gu masters' work.

items.description: A tiny larva sealed in wax. The Hao Sect denies it ever sold one.

items.useEffect: A Heart-Eroding Pill was given to the victim.
items.name: Heart-Eroding Pill

poison.debuff: +50 Impurity, applied over three days (+17 a day). If the target has 20+ Impurity: −50 Qi, −4 Qi Bars, −10 Mobility and −10 Endurance.
poison.gimmick: Slow poison: no symptoms for a day, so the victim rarely knows who gave it.
poison.activation: Disguised as an ordinary pill or sweet.

items.description: Looks exactly like a medicinal pill. That is the point.

items.useEffect: T1 Metal purification: halves a T1 poison and removes its gimmick; halves a T2 poison's numbers. Useless against Fire, weaker against Earth.
items.name: Golden Needle Antidote
items.description: Acupuncture needles dipped in a bitter tincture.

items.useEffect: T1 Fire purification: halves a T1 poison and removes its gimmick; halves a T2 poison's numbers. Useless against Water, weaker against Wood.
items.name: Red Ember Antidote
items.description: Phoenix tail fern charred over embers.

items.useEffect: T1 Water purification: halves a T1 poison and removes its gimmick; halves a T2 poison's numbers. Useless against Earth, weaker against Metal.
items.name: Black Water Antidote
items.description: A dark decoction that tastes of river mud.

items.useEffect: T2 Wood purification: removes T1 poisons, halves T2 and removes its gimmick, halves T3. Useless against Metal, weaker against Fire.
items.name: Jade Dew Antidote

purification.gimmick: Also halves any poison's gimmick duration, even ones it can't cure.

items.description: Dew collected in a jade bowl, steeped with five herbs.

items.useEffect: T2 Water purification: removes T1 poisons, halves T2 and removes its gimmick, halves T3. Useless against Earth, weaker against Metal.
items.name: Snow Lotus Antidote

purification.gimmick: Cools the blood: the user loses 3 Impurity even if there was no poison.

items.description: A sliver of snow lotus in cold spring water.

items.useEffect: T3 Earth purification: removes T1 and T2 poisons, halves T3 and removes its gimmick. Weaker against Wood.
items.name: Hundred Poisons Elixir

purification.gimmick: Works on any element at one tier lower if its own element is weak against it.

items.description: The Tang Clan's answer to its own poisons. They sell very few.
